These features exhibit a sharp gradient transition from the low-intensity dark background to a high-intensity light-colored perimeter.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: There is a high spatial density of localized, solid high-intensity white pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, particularly concentrated in the upper-right dorsal region and scattered along the mid-lateral ridge.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the large lower-left C-shape, the central cluster of three small rings, and the prominent high-intensity blob in the upper-central region form a distinct scalene triangle, while other minor keypoints across the mid-section create an elongated polygonal chain.
